Cost: 500eb (Expensive)
Type: Cyberarm (Foundational)
Install: Mall
Humanity Loss: None
Option Slots: uses 1, provides 5

A fingerless Smart Glove that counts as a Modular Finger Cyberhand for up to 5 Cyberfingers. They fit over the user's own fingers and add no extra digits. An Exoglove can't take Cyberarm or Cyberlimb Options. While worn, options in its Cyberfingers are usable, and options in the hand underneath aren't. Arm-based cyberware such as Cyberdecks and Popup Weapons still works. Putting it on or taking it off is an Action. A Cyberarm option costs the same to buy and install here as in a Cyberarm. It can't be concealed, but it's common enough among civilians not to draw attention.

Foundry notes:

  • Worn, not surgically installed: no Humanity Loss. Install it like cyberware so the sheet tracks the Cyberfingers in it, as the core system does for Smart Glasses and the Battleglove.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware Alternatives > Battle/Smart Gloves).
